title: Engineering agent system with OpenClaw as reference
description: A multi-turn chat evaluation case for testing wiki-native retrieval, context reuse, citations, and architecture synthesis across Agent Loop, Memory, MCP, A2A, Routing, and OpenClaw pages.
topic: Build an engineering Agent system with multi-turn reasoning, tool use, memory, routing, and multi-agent collaboration, using OpenClaw as a reference implementation.

turns.question: Agent 系统中的 Agent Loop 到底是什么？它和普通 Workflow 的本质区别是什么？
